result.message: 2025年11月・12月の完了注文の売上を、地域名昇順で示します。差額は12月売上−11月売上です。

  c.region AS "地域",
  COALESCE(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_at < '2025-12-01'::date), 0) AS "11月売上",
  COALESCE(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-12-01'::date), 0) AS "12月売上",
  (COALESCE(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-12-01'::date), 0)) - (COALESCE(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_at < '2025-12-01'::date), 0)) AS "差額"
FROM demo.orders AS o
JOIN demo.customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN demo.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE
  o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.ordered_at >= '2025-11-01'::date
  AND o.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'::date
GROUP BY
  c.region
ORDER BY
  c.region ASC
